title: Turkish Concessive Clause ('Even If' -se bile)
explanation: Combine the conditional suffix '-se/-sa' with the word 'bile' (even) to mean 'even if' (e.g., gelse bile = even if he/she comes).

example_translations.ex_trbile_1: Even if he/she comes tomorrow, I won't be able to see him/her.

common_error_explanations.err_trbile_1: Use '-se bile' to express 'even if' conditions.
